author: Unreal Engine
description:
Fast-paced action RPG Phantom Blade Zero takes full advantage of Unreal Engine 5 to achieve scale and quality with S-Game's small team 🔪

Motion Matching using actual master martial artists, Nanite & Lumen for more ambitious graphic fidelity and more! Take a look at what S-Game founder & CEO Soulframe had to say on the use of UE in the game! You can grab the game tomorrow on the Epic Games Store!: https://store.epicgames.com/p/phantom-blade-zero-e78a35
title: Fast-paced action RPG Phantom Blade Zero takes full advantage of Unreal Engine 5
